description: Fetches organization-level memberships for a Trello organization, with options to filter members and include their details; does not return board-specific memberships.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for fetching memberships of a Trello organization.

filter.description: Filters the list of memberships. Accepts 'all' or a comma-separated list of types: 'active', 'admin', 'deactivated', 'me', 'normal'.
filter.title: Filter

idOrg.description: The unique identifier (ID) or name of the Trello organization for which to retrieve memberships.
idOrg.title: Id Org

member.description: Whether to include full member objects in the response. Set to 'true' to include member details, 'false' to exclude. Defaults to 'false' if omitted.
member.title: Member

member_fields.description: Comma-separated list of member fields to return when 'member' is 'true'. Use 'all' for all fields, or specify individual fields. Available fields: avatarHash, bio, bioData, confirmed, fullName, idPremOrgsAdmin, initials, memberType, products, status, url, username. Defaults to 'fullName,username' if omitted.
member_fields.title: Member Fields

inputSchema.title: GetOrganizationsMembershipsByIdOrgRequest

name: get_organizations_memberships_by_id_org

GetOrganizationsMembershipsByIdOrgRespon.description: Contains the retrieved Trello organization memberships.

memberships.description: List of organization memberships. Each membership includes id, id_member, member_type (admin/normal), unconfirmed, deactivated, and optionally member details.
memberships.title: Memberships

GetOrganizationsMembershipsByIdOrgRespon.title: GetOrganizationsMembershipsByIdOrgResponse

MemberDetails.description: Details about a member when member=true is specified.

confirmed.description: Whether the member account is confirmed
confirmed.title: Confirmed

MemberDetails.title: MemberDetails

member.description: Nested member object (available when using member query parameters)
member.title: Member
